description: Use this when the user says they have bought or own materials and wants them on their shelf. Adds catalog materials by name or CAS, or their own new ones; each item can carry the bottle strength, solvent, stock in grams, price per gram, supplier and lot. Without a strength, a catalog material gets its usual working dilution (in DPG unless a solvent is given), else neat. A list can also come as pasted text or an attached file: one material per line, or a table whose header row names the columns. Names that match nothing come back with suggestions.

file.description: A list the user attached in the chat: CSV, TSV, TXT or Excel (.xlsx).

newMaterial.description: Only for a material the catalog does not have: create it as the user's own material.

name: add_to_shelf
title: Add materials to your shelf
